Class navigation opens Google Maps with the teaching building as the destination. Google Maps uses its own location permission for directions. When Google travel estimates are configured, our backend sends the route endpoints to Google. The app does not store a location history.
Maps and routes provided by Google Maps.
Finding the building of each class from the location code in your timetable and noticing when you have arrived.
Outlines and location codes of the University of Melbourne\'s campus buildings, bundled with the app.
Rain or heat at your class\'s building adds a few minutes to the departure reminder.
Public transport times, once the service has been switched on for this app.
Public transport journeys are planned by Transitous, a community-run router working from open timetable data, including Transport Victoria\'s.
The distance and travel time to your next class.
%1$s, available under the Open Database Licence. Walking and driving times are routed by the OSRM servers that FOSSGIS e.V. runs for the OpenStreetMap community.
